test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 31 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If cotθ = 3/4, find the value of 1 + tan²θ.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

cot θ = 3/4 ⇒ tan θ = 4/3

Identity: 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ

Using 3-4-5 triplet: Base = 3, Perp = 4, Hyp = 5

sec θ = Hyp / Base = 5/3

1 + tan²θ = (5/3)² = 25/9

**∴ The correct answer is 25/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** cot θ = 3/4

**Formula Used:** tan θ = 1 / cot θ | 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f24d75d5201e401c3790a16c91eebcd74a76f8f37ca25b71f5b93e447d9f550b.png] 

⇒ tan θ = 1 / (3/4) = 4/3

⇒ tan²θ = (4/3)² = 16/9

⇒ 1 + tan²θ = 1 + 16/9

⇒ (9 + 16) / 9 = 25/9

**∴ The correct answer is 25/9.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Trigonometric Identities

Fundamental relations include sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

Trigonometric ratios are related as tan θ = 1 / cot θ, sec θ = 1 / cos θ, and cosec θ = 1 / sin θ.

Pythagorean Triplets

Sets of three positive integers (a, b, c) such that a² + b² = c², commonly used triplets include (3, 4, 5) and (5, 12, 13).
